description: Shows the notes going past on an MPX stream and the harmony they are played against, and passes the stream on unchanged

params.text: Freezes the display so a note that has gone past can be read

inputs.text: Takes the note stream from an MPX output

outputs.text: Carries the same stream on unchanged, so this can be placed anywhere in a chain without altering it

notes: an MPX cable carries no voltage, so a scope says nothing about it; this is the only way to read what is on one
mpx IN takes a note stream from the mpx OUT of another DreamerMPX module, and the module does nothing until one is patched there
mpx OUT carries a note stream, not a voltage; patch it to another DreamerMPX module's mpx IN, or to mpxOut where ordinary voltages are wanted
up to four MPX cables can be patched into the one MPX input, and the notes arriving on them are merged
a cable between two MPX jacks turns pink once it has taken; a cable from an MPX jack to anything else keeps its ordinary colour and carries nothing
nothing is shown until an MPX output is patched to the input
an MPX cable carries a note stream rather than a voltage and goes to an MPX input; mpxOut turns a stream back into gates and pitch for the wider rack
